text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much. ...Were you 
watching?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's Make Debut came to a close 
without a hitch. It seems she was able to 
keep her instincts in check.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Mmm. I wonder..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I'm being completely honest... I feel 
relieved.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm so relieved... that nothing bad 
happened...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Despite offering those words of 
comfort, deep inside, a lingering doubt 
remained— was it really okay to leave 
things like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because she feared her instincts 
too much and repressed them... I felt her 
running didn't fully bring out the best in 
her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is the Triple Tiara. With her 
current abilities, reaching that lofty 
peak will be tough. Which means, going 
forward—
choice_data_list:
(I won't be able to move forward unless I 
learn to use my instincts properly...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? ...Do you have some kind of 
concern...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shook off my doubts. Seeing her so 
relieved that her instincts hadn't 
surfaced, there was no way I could suggest 
relying on them.
choice_data_list:
(Let's think of a way to get stronger 
without relying on instinct)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You want to focus on training... 
throughout the Junior Class, is that 
right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd love to do that.
Yeah, I'd like you to let me do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are so many uncertainties regarding 
her instincts and countless factors to 
consider. Taking our time, our plan is to 
build her core strength through training.
choice_data_list: What are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...That's not a problem for me either.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I will obey your words, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. If anything comes up, tell me 
right away.

Thank you. If you need anything, just let 
me know, okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Well then, I'll see you later.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer seemed to be pondering something, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Was today's race truly... not very 
good, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text: (—See? It has to be me.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please stop...

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
(See? You understand now, don't you? You 
should just let me run as I am.)

text_block_list.name: Inner Crimson
text_block_list.text:
(If I do that— that person will be so, so 
much more pleased...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...! Just as... it is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...No. I... I can't do that."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Anything but that...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, train thoroughly and prepare for 
the ultimate goal of the Tiara route— In 
the meantime, I should... sort through my 
thoughts.
